alertas.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE gfw_integrated_alerts__date >= '2021-01-01'

perdida.sql: SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss__year, SUM(area__ha) FROM results WHERE umd_tree_cover_loss__year >= 2021 AND umd_tree_cover_density_2000__percent > 30 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss__year

bosque_natural.sql: SELECT sbtn_natural_forests_map__class, SUM(area__ha) FROM results GROUP BY sbtn_natural_forests_map__class

alertas_dist.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE umd_glad_dist_alerts__date >= '2021-01-01'
